user.title: Connect your PostNL account
user.description: First open [PostNL sign in]({auth_url}). Sign in. After login the browser tries to open `postnl://login?...`. Copy that complete callback URL and paste it below.

data_description.callback_url: The complete URL starting with postnl://login?code=...

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to PostNL again
reauth_confirm.description: Your PostNL session expired. Open [PostNL sign in]({auth_url}), sign in and paste the complete `postnl://login?...` callback URL below.

error.invalid_auth: The PostNL sign-in is invalid or expired. Try again.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach PostNL or process the callback. Try again.

abort.already_configured: This PostNL account is already configured.
